title: Diver sucked into a giant grouper's mouth

tellings.quote: curious so it came up behind him and it opened its mouth and he got sucked backwards into this fish mouth

plain: In the 1960s, a diver working at an oil platform in the Gulf of Mexico was sucked backwards into the mouth of a giant grouper, a huge fish that had come up behind him out of curiosity. Joe McMoneagle tells Michels the story as something he heard from the man involved: the fish "opened its mouth and he got sucked backwards into this fish mouth."
